question: In India, the musical instrument “Flute” is also known as _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bansuri__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The flute is an instrument that comes under the class **Sushira Vadya(Wind instrument).**
 
• **Exponents: **Hariprasad Chaurasiya, Panna lal Ghosh, Rajendra Prasanna, Rajendra Kulkarni.
 
• The flute is associated with the Hindu God** Krishna**.
 
• The flute is mentioned** in Rigveda** as the **Nadi and Tunava.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samudragupta,** a Gupta emperor is associated with Veena.
 
• **Tabla Exponents**: Ustaad Allah Rakha, Zakir Hussain, Nikhil Ghosh, Pt. Swapan Chaudhary, Anokhelal Mishra.
 
• **Veena Exponents: **Aurangzeb, S. Balachander

 
 

 **Musical instrument types**
 **Examples**
 
 

 Tantu Vadya (stringed instruments)
 Sitar, Veena, Santoorr, Sarod.
 
 

 Sushir Vadya (wind instruments)
 Flute, Shehnai, Poongi, Baanki, Aerophone.
 
 

 Avanaddha Vadya ( Stretched skin instrument)
 Tabla, Dholak, Damroo, Mridanga.
 
 

 Ghan Vadya (Vibrate when stuck )
 Manjira, Chimta, Ghatam, Morchang.
